item.title: President Lee: "Maintain the Maximum Oil Price System and Further Lower the Price" (이 대통령 “석유 최고가격제 유지하고, 가격 더 낮춰야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 23rd, "We should boldly maintain the maximum oil price system and I think we need to lower the cap a bit more." (이재명 대통령이 23일 “과감하게 석유 최고가격제는 더 유지하고, 최고가격도 좀 낮춰야 할 거 같다”고 말했다.)

Speaking at a Cabinet meeting held at the Presidential Office on the same day, President Lee stated, "The rising prices of petroleum products are putting a burden on living costs. Since we anticipate excess tax revenue from semiconductors and other sectors, lowering the oil tax won't put too much strain on the finances. Doesn't this help expand the consumption capacity of ordinary people?" (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “석유류 제품 가격이 올라서 물가부담이 있다. 우리가 반도체 등 초과 세수가 예상이 되는 만큼 유류세를 좀 낮춰도 재정부담이 그렇게 크지 않다. 이게 서민의 소비 여력 확대에 도움이 된다는 거 아니냐”며 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee also instructed that research be conducted on support measures for low-income households amid income polarization. He confirmed with Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol, "Is there no financial resource to add income support policies for ordinary people?" Deputy Prime Minister Koo responded, "We can utilize existing budgets or adjust funds by up to 20%." This response is interpreted as meaning that even if securing additional financial resources is challenging, funding for supporting ordinary people can be secured through adjustments to existing budgets or fund management plans. <<> In response, President Lee emphasized, "Inflation is high, and income polarization is severe. Even in the stock market, only large blue-chip stocks are rising, leading to polarization. We need to study income support measures." <<> Reporters: Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr, Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 소득 양극화로 인한 서민 소득지원 방안도 연구하라고 지시했다. 이 대통령은 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관에게 “서민들에 대한 소득지원 정책을 추가하기엔 재원이 없냐”고 확인했고, 구 부총리는 “기존 예산을 활용하거나 기금을 20% 변경할 수 있다”고 답했다. 추가 재원 마련이 쉽지 않더라도 기존 예산이나 기금 운용계획 조정을 통해 서민 지원 재원을 확보할 수 있다는 취지로 답한 것으로 풀이된다.)

item.title: Election Commission Members Largely Absent from Special Investigation Committee, Rebuked as "Collective Defiance Against the People" (선관위원들, 국조특위에 대거 불출석…“국민에 집단항명” 질타)
item.description:
The second plenary session of the "Special Committee for Parliamentary Investigation into the Vote Paper Shortage Incident and Infringement of Citizens' Suffrage, and Electoral Management Reform" (Special Investigation Committee) was held at the National Assembly on the 23rd to address the vote paper shortage during the June 3 local elections. However, all seven non-standing members of the National Election Commission, former Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission Chairperson Oh Min-seok, former Songpa District Election Commission Chairperson Min So-young, and other non-standing members were largely absent. Lawmakers from both the ruling and opposition parties criticized this unanimously as "irresponsible" and "a collective defiance against the people," demanding their attendance in the afternoon. <<> Shin Dong-wook, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, stated, "Looking at the situation with witnesses and references, I am deeply concerned whether the Election Commission is even in a posture to respond to the investigation into the truth." On this day, the Special Investigation Committee requested the attendance of 43 Election Commission officials, including former National Election Commission Chairperson Noh Tae-ak, but only a few, such as former Chairperson Noh and Acting National Election Commission Chairperson Wi Cheol-hwan, showed up. <<> Lawmaker Shin pointed out, "Since June 3, countless citizens have been unable to return home and are sleeping at Jamsil (Olympic Park). These people (Election Commission members) didn't even show up for work on election day, and now that the parliamentary investigation is underway, where are they?" <<> Kim Young-bae, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, also criticized, "Former Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission Chairperson Oh Min-seok is a public official currently serving as the head of the Seoul Central District Court. He is fully aware of what this incident means for our constitutional order. Yet, his absence from this session clearly shows the people how irresponsible his attitude is." <<> In response, Acting Chairperson Wi said, "We held a plenary session (of the National Election Commission) yesterday. I stated in principle that all members should attend and thoroughly brief the committee and the people on the facts. Since they agreed in principle, I believe they will attend soon." <<> Yoon Sang-hyun, Chairperson of the Special Investigation Committee, stated, "As chairperson, I express strong regret. While this is a voluntary attendance without legal compulsion, this attitude is highly inappropriate given the will of the people and this committee to uncover the truth. I convey a strong request for them to come out even now." <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 따지기 위한 ‘투표용지 부족사태 등 국민참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리개혁 국정조사 특별위원회’(국조특위) 2차 전체회의가 23일 국회에서 열렸으나, 중앙선거관리위원회 비상임 위원 7명 전원, 서울시선관위 오민석 전 위원장, 송파구선관위 민소영 전 위원장 등과 비상임위원들이 대거 불출석했다. 여야 의원들은 “무책임하다”, “국민에 대한 집단항명”이라고 한 목소리로 비판하며 오후 출석을 요구했다.)

item.title: President Lee Calls Death of Female Firefighter Forced to Drink “Worst Abuse of Power” (이 대통령, 음주 강요받다 숨진 여성 소방관 사건에 “최악 갑질”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 23rd regarding the female firefighter who died after being forced to drink alcohol that it was “the worst abuse of power.” (이재명 대통령이 23일 음주 등을 강요받다 숨진 여성 소방관과 관련해 “최악의 갑질”이라고 말했다.)

Mentioning this case during a cabinet meeting presided over at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae that day, President Lee said, “When I asked the Office for Government Policy Coordination to investigate it a while ago, it turned out to be true,” adding, “In the end, how severe must the pain of the deceased have been, and how heartbroken must her boyfriend and family be? And (for those who) ignored the inspection, how upset must they have felt?” (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 이 사건을 언급하며 “얼마 전 국무조정실에 조사해보라고 했더니 사실로 드러났다”며 “결국 유명을 달리한 고인의 고통은 얼마나 심각했을 것이며, 남자친구와 가족들은 얼마나 가슴 아팠겠냐. 또 (감찰을) 묵살해서 얼마나 속이 쓰렸겠냐”고 말했다.)

President Lee continued, “The problem is that they don’t realize it’s a serious act,” and noted, “There was a tendency to think, ‘That much is okay.’ I hope each ministry and agency will pay special attention. Be sure to conduct internal organizational checks.” Furthermore, President Lee said, “Whether it’s trying to seat a female employee next to the boss, making a female employee pour drinks, or forcibly taking her to a secondary gathering and making her chug. If she says she doesn’t want to drink, why force her? Drink it yourself,” and urged, “Please ensure that workplace abuse of power does not recur.” (이 대통령은 이어 “문제는 그게 심각한 행위인지 모른다는 것”이라며 “‘그 정도는 할 수 있지’라고 생각하는 경향이 있었다. 각 부처, 청에서 각별히 챙겨주면 좋겠다. 내부 조직 점검을 꼭 해보라”고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “여직원을 상사 옆자리에 앉히려 한다든지 여성 직원에게 술 따르게 한다든지 2차에 강제로 데려가 원샷을 시킨다든지. 술이 싫다는데 왜 원샷을 시키냐. 자기나 먹지”라며 “직장 내 갑질이 다시 나오지 않게 챙겨달라”고 말했다.)

Earlier, in October last year, a female public employee from the Gwangju Gwangsan Fire Station died due to workplace harassment, but at the time, the Gwangju Fire Headquarters dismissed it as a relationship issue with her fiancé and did not even conduct an inspection for over five months. Subsequently, the Office for Government Policy Coordination confirmed through an investigation that workplace harassment had indeed occurred. (앞서 지난해 10월 광주 광산소방서 소속 여성 공무원이 직장 내 괴롭힘으로 숨졌으나 당시 광주소방본부는 약혼자와 관계 문제로 치부하며 5개월이 넘도록 감찰조차 하지 않았다. 이후 국무조정실이 조사를 통해 직장 내 괴롭힘을 사실로 확인했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee says "Exchange rate around 1,500 won is excessive... needs to drop further" (이 대통령 “환율 1500원 중반은 과해…더 떨어져야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 23rd regarding the high exchange rate that "(the dollar-won exchange rate) hovering around the mid-1,500 won level is excessive compared to fundamentals." (이재명 대통령이 23일 고환율과 관련해 “(달러·원 환율이) 1500원 중반대는 펀더멘털에 비해 과하다”고 말했다.)

In a cabinet meeting presided over at the Blue House that day, President Lee said, "Our country's exports are at an all-time high, and the current account surplus is also at an all-time high, beyond imagination. So, the exchange rate should normally be dropping," making these remarks. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “우리나라 수출도 사상 최대인데다 경상 흑자도 사상 최대고, 상상 이상이다. 그럼 원래는 환율이 떨어져야 한다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee cited the weak yen and foreign investment in the domestic stock market as reasons for the high exchange rate. President Lee said, "The real reasons for the unstable exchange rate are the strong dollar and the yen... When the Korean stock market improves, foreign buying should come in, supplying dollars. But on the contrary, as it has increased too rapidly, foreign holdings have expanded, and the management of Korean assets has grown, creating a situation where it needs to be reduced." This is interpreted as reflecting the perception that while exports and the current account are performing well, the won's value should be stronger, but the strong dollar, weak yen, and position adjustments by foreign investors are preventing the exchange rate from falling. (이 대통령은 고환율 원인으로 엔화 약세와 국내 주식시장의 외국인 투자 등을 꼽았다. 이 대통령은 “환율이 불안한 진짜 이유는 달러 강세와 엔화 때문”이라며 “한국 주식시장이 좋아지면 외국인 매수가 들어와 달러 공급이 돼야 하는데, 반대로 너무 급격히 늘어나니 외국인 포션이 늘어서 한국물 관리 포션이 커져서 줄여야 된 상황이 된 것”이라고 말했다. 수출과 경상수지가 호조를 보이는 만큼 원화 가치가 더 강해야 하지만, 달러 강세와 엔화 약세, 외국인 투자자들의 포지션 조정 등이 환율 하락을 막고 있다는 인식을 드러낸 것으로 해석된다.)

President Lee asked Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-cheol, "Is this more of a short-term issue rather than a structural one?" to which Deputy Prime Minister Koo replied, "Yes." President Lee said, "Isn't the point when foreigners' so-called rebalancing is coming to an end also the point when the sharp rise in stock prices stops?" adding, "Ultimately, this is part of the normalization process, and it's a matter of time." (이 대통령은 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관에게 “이게 구조적 문제라기보다 단기적 문제냐”고 물었고, 구 부총리는 “그렇다”고 답했다. 이 대통령은 “외국인들의 소위 리밸런싱이 끝나갈 시점이 주가의 급격한 상승이 멈추는 시점 아니냐”며 “결국 이게 정상화 과정이기도 하고, 시간이 문제”라고 말했다.)

Reporters: Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: North Korean UNESCO Official’s Video Speech at Jeju Forum Ultimately Canceled (북한 유네스코 인사 ‘제주포럼' 화상 연설 결국 무산)
item.description:
The video speech participation of a North Korean official, which was being pursued by the international academic conference "Jeju Forum," has ultimately been canceled. An official from the Jeju Peace Institute, which organizes the Jeju Forum, stated on the 23rd that UNESCO recently notified them that a different education officer, rather than the North Korean official, would deliver the video speech. (국제 학술회의 ‘제주포럼'이 추진하던 북측 인사의 화상 연설 참여가 결국 무산됐다. 제주포럼을 주관하는 제주평화연구원 관계자는 최근 유네스코가 북측 인사가 아닌 다른 교육담당관을 화상 연설자로 통보했다고 23일 밝혔다.)

The Jeju Forum, opening on the 24th, had been working to arrange Dr. Zhang Guangchul, head of the Education Policy Section at UNESCO’s Headquarters’ Policy and Lifelong Learning Division, as a video speaker for the "UNESCO and the Future of Education" session on the third day of the event, the 26th. On the 16th, a Ministry of Unification official had stated, "The organizers (of the Jeju Forum) reported contact with North Korean residents, and (the Ministry of Unification) accepted it." A Jeju Forum official told The Hankyoreh on the 23rd, "Last week, UNESCO contacted us to say they would replace Dr. Zhang Guangchul with a different UNESCO official, without giving a reason for the change." According to the website and other sources, Dr. Zhang earned a doctorate in pedagogy from Kim Hyong Jik University of Education in North Korea, worked at the North Korean Ministry of Education, and was dispatched to UNESCO, where he has held various positions at UNESCO headquarters and regional offices as an education expert. <<> The push for Dr. Zhang’s participation in the Jeju Forum was seen as an opportunity to gauge the possibility of inter-Korean exchange on an international multilateral diplomatic stage in a non-political field, but it ultimately fell through. With North Korea continuing its hostile policies toward the South under a "hostile two states" stance, the fact that the speech plan became public in South Korea may have made the North feel burdened, leading to its denial of participation. <<> The "Jeju Forum" is an international academic conference launched by Jeju City in 2001, and this year's event is co-hosted with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. This year’s Jeju Forum, under the main theme "Reimagining Cooperation in an Age of Division," consists of a total of over 70 sessions. <<> Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (24일 개막하는 제주포럼은 행사 3일차인 26일 ‘유네스코와 교육의 미래' 세션의 화상 참여 연사로 유네스코 본부 정책·평생교육국의 교육정책 부서장인 장광철 박사 섭외를 추진해 왔다. 앞서 16일 통일부 당국자는 “(제주포럼) 주최 쪽에서 북한 주민접촉신고를 했고, (통일부가) 이를 수리했다”고 밝힌 바 있다. 제주포럼 관계자는 23일 한겨레에 “지난주 유네스코 측에서 장광철 박사가 아닌 다른 유네스코 관계자로 바꾼다고 연락을 해왔고 교체 이유는 밝히지 않았다”고 말했다. 홈페이지 등에 따르면 장 박사는 북한 김형직사범대학에서 교육학 박사 학위를 받고 북한 교육성에서 근무하다 유네스코에 파견돼 유네스코 본부와 지역사무소에서 다양한 보직을 거친 교육전문가다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Nominee Han Sung-sook Sells Two Additional Homes After Jamsil Apartment, Now a One-Home Owner (한성숙 총리 후보자, 잠실 아파트 이어 주택 2채 추가 매각…이젠 1주택자)
item.description:
Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook has sold a total of three properties she owned, ultimately retaining just one home in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, her personnel confirmation preparation team announced on the 23rd. (한성숙 국무총리 후보자가 보유 주택 총 3채를 매각해 최종적으로 서울 종로구 삼청동에 있는 주택 1채만을 보유하게 됐다고 인사청문준비단이 23일 밝혔다.)

The personnel confirmation preparation team for nominee Han issued a notice stating that she has additionally disposed of an officetel in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, and a country house in Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi Province. It also reported that the ownership transfer for the Jamsil apartment in Songpa-gu, Seoul, which was sold in May, has been completed. (한 후보자 인사청문준비단은 이날 공지를 내어 한 후보자가 서울 강남구 역삼동 오피스텔과 경기도 양평군 전원주택을 추가로 처분했다고 밝혔다. 또 지난 5월 매각한 서울 송파구 잠실 아파트는 소유권 이전까지 완료했다고 전했다.)

The preparation team explained, "Among the three disposed properties, the Jamsil apartment was sold at a price lower than the market value, while the Yeoksam-dong officetel and the Yangpyeong country house were sold at prices lower than their acquisition costs," adding, "Out of the profit from the Jamsil apartment sale, 500 million won was donated to an international relief and development organization." (준비단은 “처분한 3개 주택 중 잠실 아파트는 시세보다 낮은 가격으로 매각했고, 역삼동 오피스텔과 양평 전원주택은 취득가보다도 낮은 가격으로 매각했다”며 “잠실 아파트 매매 차익 중 5억원은 국제구호개발 단체에 기부한 바 있다”고 설명했다.)

Nominee Han stated, "I deeply feel the heavy responsibility of a high-ranking public official and will proactively implement the government's real estate policy direction." (한 후보자는 “고위 공직자의 무거운 책임감을 절감하며 정부의 부동산 정책 기조를 선도적으로 이행하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Exclusive] Half of Election Commissions Nationwide Prepared Ballots Based on Population Figures from '5 Months Earlier' ([단독] 전국 선관위 절반, ‘5개월 전’ 인구 기준 투표용지 준비했다)
item.description:
Out of 256 city, county, and district election commissions nationwide, 126—nearly half—prepared ballots based on the Ministry of the Interior and Safety's population reference date at the end of the previous year, rather than the voter list compilation date. (전국 시·군·구 선거관리위원회 256곳 중 절반에 육박하는 126곳이 선거인 명부 작성일 기준이 아니라 전년도 말 행정안전부 인구기준일을 기준으로 투표용지를 준비한 것으로 나타났다.)

According to data submitted by the National Election Commission (NEC) to the office of Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Nam-hee on the 23rd, 126 commissions printed ballots based on the Ministry's population reference date (December 31 of last year), while 130 used the voter list compilation date (May 12 of this year). (23일 김남희 더불어민주당 의원실이 중앙선관위로부터 제출받은 자료를 보면, 행정안전부 인구기준일(지난해 12월31일)을 기준으로 투표용지를 인쇄한 곳은 126곳이다. 선거인 명부 작성일(올해 5월12일)을 기준으로 했다는 곳은 130곳이었다.)

In its activity report released on the 19th, the Fact-Finding Committee on the NEC Incident pointed out, "It is reasonable to calculate the number of printed ballots based on the voter list compilation date closest to election day. However, most district, county, and city commissions in Seoul calculated based on the estimated voter count as of the population reference date of December 31 last year." (선관위 사태 진상규명위원회는 지난 19일 활동결과 보고서에서 “선거일에 가장 가까운 선거인명부 작성일을 기준으로 투표용지 인쇄매수를 산정하는 것이 합리적”이라면서 “그러나 대부분의 서울시 관내 구·시·군 위원회에서는 지난해 12월31일 인구기준일 현재 예상 선거인 수를 기준으로 산정했다”라고 짚었다.)

Taking the case of Seoul's Songpa District, where actual voting was suspended due to a ballot shortage, the voter count as of December 31 last year (with Jamsil 4-dong only using the reference date of March 31 this year) was 564,438 (excluding absentee votes), compared to 565,445 as of the voter list compilation date on election day—a difference of 1,007 people. Furthermore, standards varied by polling station. The committee noted, "This failure to account for population changes during that period, such as moves or relocations into rebuilt apartment complexes, increased the likelihood of ballot shortages." (투표용지 부족으로 실제 투표가 중단됐던 서울 송파구 사례만 보더라도 투표용지 인쇄매수 결정 기준일인 지난해 12월31일(잠실4동만 지난 3월31일기준) 선거인수는 56만4438명(거소 제외)으로, 선거일 명부 작성일 기준 56만5445명과는 1007명의 차이가 있다. 게다가 투표소별 기준 또한 제각각이었다. 진상규명위는 “해당 기간 사이에 이사, 재건축 아파트 입주 등 인구 변동사항을 고려하지 않은 결과로 이로 인해 투표용지 부족사태가 발생할 가능성이 높아졌다”라고 지적했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Nam-hee stated, "Despite having the most accurate standard—the voter list compilation date—nearly half of the election commissions using population statistics from six months ago is evidence of the NEC's incompetence, complacency, and lax administration nationwide." She added, "We must identify those responsible through a parliamentary investigation, review measures to codify the criteria for calculating the number of printed ballots into law, and protect citizens' voting rights." (김남희 의원은 “선거인명부 작성일이라는 가장 정확한 기준을 두고도, 절반에 가까운 선관위가 반년 전 인구 통계를 끌어다 쓴 것은 선관위의 무능과 안일함, 그리고 졸속 행정이 전국적으로 만연했다는 증거”라며 “국정조사를 통해 책임자를 반드시 가려내고, 인쇄매수 산정 기준을 법률에 명문화하는 방안 등을 검토해 국민의 참정권을 지켜내야 한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min: jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Exclusive] "Did not receive report on ballot reduction" – Is Noh Tae-ak lying? Listed on page 1 of last year's agenda ([단독] “투표지 축소 보고 못 받아” 노태악 거짓말인가…지난해 안건지 1쪽에 명시돼)
item.description:
It has been confirmed that the first page of the agenda for the Central Election Management Committee meeting last November, attended by former Chairman Noh Tae-ak, explicitly stated the "guideline for 50% reduction in ballot printing." <<> According to the 15th committee meeting agenda submitted by the office of lawmaker Yoon Geon-young to the Central Election Management Committee on the 23rd, the third item under the "Review of Amendments to Public Election Management Rules, etc." list on the first page—titled "Review of Public Election Procedure Manuals and Guidelines"—specified the agenda item "Reduction of the calculation rate for ballot printing quantity on election day." Details further noted that for local elections, the calculation rate would be reduced from 60% to 50%. Additionally, on page 41 of the agenda, the "Reduction of the calculation rate for ballot printing quantity on election day" was summarized and reported, stating that under the current situation, "the number of ballots issued relative to the printed quantity on election day has been continuously decreasing due to the rise in early voting rates, leading to a decline in election-day voter turnout." Accordingly, the Central Election Management Committee proposed as an improvement measure "reducing the calculation rate for ballot printing quantity from 60% to 50% for local elections." The committee also noted that "adjustments can be made for individual polling districts considering factors such as expected early voting rates." <<> Earlier, former Chairman Noh had responded to the Election Commission's fact-finding committee that he had never received a prior report on the reduction of ballot printing quantities. However, after it was revealed that the agenda item had been reported at the 15th Central Election Management Committee meeting attended by Chairman Noh on November 24 last year, former Chairman Noh reportedly stated, "I initially said I had not received a report based on memory, but I have now confirmed that it was included in the reported agenda," according to Jo Hyeon-wook, head of the Election Commission's fact-finding committee. <<> Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 참석한 지난해 11월 중앙선관위 위원회의 안건지 첫 쪽에 ‘투표용지 50% 축소 인쇄 지침’이 명시돼있던 것으로 확인됐다.)

item.title: People Power Party's Kim Seong-tae: "Jang Dong-hyuk Seems to Show No Intention of Resigning" (국힘 김성태 “장동혁, 전혀 사퇴 의지 안 보인다더라”)
item.description:
Amid growing attention on the status of Jang Dong-hyuk, the People Power Party (PPP) leader, who was hospitalized on the 18th, PPP's Seoul Gangseo-eul district committee chairman Kim Seong-tae stated, "I heard that (Representative Jang) shows no intention of resigning at all." (지난 18일 병원에 입원한 장동혁 국민의힘 대표 거취에 관심이 집중되는 가운데, 김성태 국민의힘 서울 강서을 당협위원장이 “(장 대표가) 전혀 사퇴할 의지는 안 보인다는 얘기를 들었다”고 밝혔다.)

Chairman Kim appeared on MBC's "Newsexternal" on the 23rd and said, "Politically, experiencing considerable chaos, and when a message of silence is needed for internal party conflicts or such issues, political leaders choose to be hospitalized," adding, "Through hospitalization, (politicians) buy time to observe the situation's development while refining their future stance. That's where Representative Jang Dong-hyuk is right now." (김 위원장은 23일 문화방송(MBC) ‘뉴스외전’에 나와 “정치적으로 상당히 난맥상을 겪고 당내 갈등이나 이런 부분에 대해 침묵의 메시지가 필요하니까 정치 지도자들이 선택하는 게 병원 입원”이라며 “병원 입원을 통해 (정치인들이) 사태 추이도 지켜보면서 향후 자신의 거취를 가다듬는 시간을 번다. 그게 장동혁 대표 지금의 시간”이라고 말했다.)

He continued, "Among conservative supporters, there's a view that it would be good for Representative Jang to both recover his health and make a decision on his position to some extent. Coincidentally, the person I met today—who happens to be a former PPP floor leader—said he met Representative Jang Dong-hyuk yesterday. However, I heard that he shows no intention of resigning at all. So, this state is being maintained." (이어 “보수 지지층 쪽에서는 장 대표가 건강도 좀 추스르면서 자신의 거취도 일정 부분 결심하고 나오는 게 좋겠다고 그러는데, 제가 오늘 (만난 사람이) 공교롭게 국민의힘 원내대표까지 하신 분인데 어제 장동혁 대표를 만났다고 한다”며 “그런데 전혀 사퇴할 의지는 안 보인다고 얘기를 들었다. 그러니까 이 상태가 계속 유지되는 것”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, Representative Jang suspended public activities after the election petition general meeting on the 17th and has been hospitalized in a Seoul hospital since the 18th, citing health issues. A party leadership official explained shortly after his admission, "Representative Jang, after his hunger strike, accumulated fatigue from local election campaign tours and on-site responses to the National Election Commission situation, leading to his hospitalization." (앞서 장 대표는 지난 17일 선거소청 의원총회 뒤 공개 활동을 중단하고 18일부터 건강상의 문제라며 서울 시내 병원에 입원한 상태다. 당 지도부 관계자는 입원 직후 “장 대표가 단식 이후 지방선거 지역 유세, 중앙선거관리위원회 사태 현장 대응 등으로 피로가 누적돼 입원했다”고 설명한 바 있다.)

While Representative Jang's discharge was anticipated on the 22nd, that same day, party chief secretary Park Jun-tae told reporters, "The party leader wished for a swift return to party affairs and consulted with medical staff today, but based on the medical staff's judgment that further treatment is necessary for now, he was unable to be discharged today." He added that "his physical strength has fundamentally declined significantly." (22일 장 대표의 퇴원 가능성이 점쳐지기도 했지만 같은 날 박준태 당대표 비서실장은 기자들을 만나 “당대표께서 조속한 당무 복귀를 원해 오늘 의료진과 협의를 했지만 당분간 더 치료를 이어가는 게 맞다는 의료진 판단에 따라서 오늘 퇴원을 못 하게 됐다”고 밝혔다. “기본적으로 체력이 많이 저하된 상태”라는 것이다.)

Meanwhile, Representative Jang posted on Facebook for the first time since his hospitalization. Regarding the first judicial ruling on the 20th that former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor for Peace Lee Hwa-young's so-called "salmon drinking party" testimony to the National Assembly was false, Representative Jang claimed, "The 'salmon drinking party' is the most horrifying fabricated incitement case in South Korean history." (한편, 장 대표는 이날 입원 뒤 처음으로 페이스북에 글을 올렸다. 장 대표는 지난 20일 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사의 이른바 ‘연어 술파티’ 국회 증언이 허위였다는 첫 사법 판단이 나온 데 대해 “‘연어 술파티’는 대한민국 역사상 가장 끔찍한 조작 선동 사건”이라고 주장했다.)

Reporting by Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Dawn Minutes of Election Commission Meeting Day After June 3 Elections... Secretariat Reports "Thought 50% Would Be Sufficient" (6·3 선거 익일 새벽 선관위 회의록…사무처 “50%면 충분하다 생각” 보고)
item.description:
<<>> At a hastily convened dawn meeting on June 4, the day after the June 3 local elections, the secretariat of the National Election Commission (NEC) reported that it "believed printing 50% of the ballots for election day would be sufficient." The meeting also saw belated criticism that the decision on the minimum ballot print run was made by the secretariat, not the central commission. ()

According to minutes of the meeting held from 12:38 a.m. to 1:50 a.m. on June 4, submitted by the NEC to the office of Rep. Kim Nam-hee of the Democratic Party of Korea on June 23, seven NEC commissioners (with two absent), including former Chairman Noh Tae-ak, were briefed on the ballot shortage situation for the local elections and future measures. The NEC submitted the minutes after anonymizing the commissioners who spoke. ( 6·3 지방선거 다음날인 4일 새벽 중앙선거관리위원회가 긴급하게 연 회의에서 사무처가 “(본투표일) 투표용지 인쇄매수는 50%면 충분하다고 생각했다”고 보고한 것으로 나타났다. 이 자리에서는 투표용지 인쇄하한 결정이 중앙위원회가 아닌 사무처에서 이뤄진 것은 부적절했다는 뒤늦은 지적도 있었다. )

At the meeting, Yoon Jae-soo, director of the election policy office, reported, "For the Songpa-gu Commission's local election turnout, it was 62.9% in the 7th election and 55% in the 8th, with early voting accounting for about 20%. So we thought printing 50% of ballots would be sufficient." He further explained, "While Songpa-gu Commission's turnout was 65.8%, combining the early voting rate of 23.3% with the election-day ballot print ratio of 50% gives a total of 73.3% printed. Looking at the number of ballots issued compared to the total printed for Songpa-gu Commission, it wasn't insufficient, but in some polling stations with low early voting rates and high election-day turnout, shortages occurred." ( 23일 김남희 더불어민주당 의원실이 중앙선관위로부터 제출받은 지난 4일 오전 0시38분∼1시50분 회의록을 보면, 노태악 전 위원장을 비롯해 선관위원 7명(2명 결석)은 지방선거 투표용지 부족 상황과 향후 대책을 보고받았다. 해당 회의록은 중앙선관위가 회의에서 발언한 선관위원을 익명 처리하고 제출했다. )

Commissioners at the meeting appeared indecisive, discussing whether to postpone the election, hold a rerun, or stop the counting. Some argued that vote boxes from unaffected polling stations should be counted, and counting continued accordingly, but the NEC's fact-finding committee later pointed out that counting had begun at the Jamsil 7-dong 2nd polling station before voting had even concluded. ( 이 자리에서 윤재수 선거정책실장은 “송파구위원회 지방선거 투표율의 경우 7회 62.9%, 8회 55%였고, 거기에 사전투표율이 20% 정도를 차지하기 때문에, 투표용지 인쇄매수는 50%면 충분하다고 생각했다”라고 보고했다. 또 “송파구위원회 투표율이 65.8%인 반면에 사전투표율 23.3%에, 선거일 투표용지 인쇄비율 50%를 합하면 73.3%가 인쇄된 것으로 볼 수 있어 송파구위원회의 전체 인쇄매수 대비 교부매수를 보더라도 부족하지 않은데, 일부 투표소의 경우 사전투표율이 낮은 반면 선거일 투표율이 높아 부족현상이 발생했다”라고 설명했다.)

One commissioner pointed out, "I think it's fundamentally not a proper procedure for the decision on the minimum ballot print run, which could lead to a serious situation, to be implemented by the secretariat without discussion by the central commission." This criticism targeted the NEC's decision in December 2023 to lower the minimum ballot print run for the local election's main voting day from 60% of eligible voters to 50%, made by Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hoon's approval rather than a commission resolution. ( 회의에 참석한 선관위원들은 선거연기, 재선거, 개표중단 여부 등을 놓고 우왕좌왕하는 모습을 보였다. 문제가 없는 투표소의 투표함은 개표하는 것이 맞는다는 의견들이 있었고, 이에 따라 개표가 계속됐지만 선관위 진상규명위는 애초 잠실7동 2투표소 투표가 끝나지 않은 시점에 개표가 시작된 것이 문제라고 짚은 바 있다.)

Commissioners also offered varying opinions on whether to postpone the election, hold a rerun, or stop the counting. One commissioner said, "I think the decision criteria should be based on the principle of proportionality. If the number of affected voters is extremely small compared to the total electorate, it's not grounds for postponing the election, rerunning, re-voting, or stopping the count, so it might be better to decide calmly after the election ends." Another commissioner suggested, "Since we can only decide on a re-vote after the counting process is complete, it would be appropriate to proceed with counting vote boxes without issues, but for Jamsil 7-dong 2nd polling station, we should temporarily halt counting until the central commission discusses and decides whether to count it." A different commissioner added, "Stopping all counting in Songpa-gu would violate the principle of proportionality, so it's preferable to count unaffected vote boxes in order and proceed with counting problematic ones after resolving the situation, then summing them up." There was also an opinion that "for council members with narrow districts, there might be backlash from those involved who think the impact is significant." One commissioner remarked, "This case is different from the 2021 Berlin rerun election that Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk of the People Power Party has cited." ( 한 위원은 “중대한 사태 초래가 예상되는 투표용지 인쇄 하한선 결정이 중앙위원회에서 논의되지 않고 사무처에서 시행하는 것이 근본적으로 제대로 된 절차는 아니라고 생각한다”라고 지적했다. 중앙선관위가 지난해 12월10일 위원회 의결이 아닌 허철훈 사무총장의 전결로 지방선거 본투표 투표용지 인쇄 매수 하한 기준을 기존 ‘유권자 수의 60%’에서 50%로 낮춘 것을 문제 삼은 것이다. )

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr ( 위원들은 선거 연기나 재선거, 개표중단 여부를 놓고 저마다 의견도 내놨다. 한 위원은 “결정 기준은 비례성의 원칙이라고 생각한다”며 “전체 선거인 수 중 문제가 된 선거인 수가 극소수일 경우 선거연기, 재선거, 재투표, 개표중단사유가 아니기 때문에 선거종료 후 차분하게 결정하는 게 좋을 듯하다”라고 말했다. 다른 위원은 “개표절차가 종료돼야 재투표여부를 판단할 수 있으므로, 문제가 없는 투표함은 정상적으로 개표하게 하되, 잠실7동 제2투표구의 경우 중앙위원회에서 논의를 거쳐 개표여부를 판단하기까지는 (개표를) 잠시 중단하는 게 맞다”는 의견을 냈다. 또다른 위원은 “송파구 전체 개표 중단은 비례성의 원칙에 맞지 않으므로, 문제없는 투표함은 순서대로 개표하고, 문제가 있는 투표함은 사태해결 후에 개표를 진행해 합산하는 게 바람직하다”라고 했다. “선거구역이 좁은 구의원의 경우 영향력이 크다고 생각하는 관련자의 반발이 있을 것으로 생각한다”는 의견도 있었다. 한 위원은 “장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 주장하는 2021년 독일 베를린 (재선거) 사건과 사안이 다르다”고 말했다. )

item.title: North Korea and China to Coordinate in Criticizing ‘South Korea-US Extended Deterrence’? Government Hopes for China’s ‘Constructive Role’ (북·중, ‘한·미 확장억제 비판’ 공조하나…정부 “중, 건설적 역할 희망”)
item.description:
As North Korea and China have successively criticized South Korea-US extended deterrence cooperation, the government has countered by asserting that North Korea’s nuclear development is the root cause, urging China to play a ‘constructive role.’ Amid Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to North Korea and moves to strengthen North Korea-China relations, attention is focused on whether the two countries are strategically joining forces to target the South Korea-US alliance. <<> At a regular briefing on the 23rd, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il rebutted the Chinese Foreign Ministry’s statement on the 18th expressing concerns over South Korea-US and US-Japan extended deterrence, stating, “Amid the advancement of North Korea’s illegal nuclear and missile programs, the South Korea-US extended deterrence cooperation is a legitimate response to protect the lives and safety of our people, and a due duty of a responsible government.” Spokesperson Park emphasized, “The South Korea-US extended deterrence fully aligns with the objectives and obligations of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT),” adding, “South Korea is faithfully fulfilling its NPT obligations and continuously reaffirming its commitment to the international non-proliferation regime.” <<> After not mentioning the North Korean nuclear issue at the Pyongyang summit on the 8th, China and North Korea have jointly criticized US extended deterrence. Following assessments that China has tacitly accepted North Korea’s nuclear status to draw North Korea as a ‘partner’ in the US-China hegemonic competition and global strategy, China is now joining North Korea in criticizing the strengthening of South Korea-US extended deterrence. <<> North Korea, through reports in the Rodong Sinmun and Korean Central News Agency on this day, revealed the results of the recently concluded 2nd Enlarged Plenary Meeting of the 9th Central Committee and criticized the meeting of the Nuclear Consultative Group (NCG), a South Korea-US extended deterrence consultative body. In particular, North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un directly criticized South Korea’s pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines and the operation of the NCG, claiming they are pushing the Korean Peninsula into a nuclear war crisis, while justifying the strengthening of North Korea’s nuclear and military forces. In response, a foreign ministry official stated, “Our development of nuclear-powered submarines is being pursued to robustly secure our security in response to the rapidly changing security environment on the Korean Peninsula, including the advancement of North Korea’s nuclear and missile capabilities.” <<> Some analyses suggest that the strategic positions of North Korea and China may not be entirely aligned in these moves. Observers note that China, wary of potentially stimulating Japan’s nuclear armament moves if it tolerates North Korea’s nuclear status, likely holds a different stance from North Korea on the nuclear issue. However, China may seek to maximize its strategic interests by adopting a stance of ‘tacit acceptance’ rather than open endorsement of North Korea’s nuclear program, which could trigger a nuclear domino effect in East Asia, including Japan’s nuclear armament. <<> South Korea’s diplomatic and security authorities reportedly view North Korea’s announcement on the plenary meeting as a routine reaction to consistently oppose South Korea-US extended deterrence, rather than a position coordinated with China. The government notes that while China has recently refrained from explicitly mentioning North Korea’s denuclearization, it maintains the phrase ‘continuity in the policy toward the Korean Peninsula,’ and continues to demand China’s role in the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula. Spokesperson Park stated, “We hope that China, as a responsible country, will play a more careful and constructive role in achieving the common goals of denuclearizing the Korean Peninsula and maintaining peace and stability in the region, based on a deep understanding of international norms and regional circumstances.” <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee: minggu@hani.co.kr (북한과 중국이 연이어 한미의 확장억제 협력을 비난하고 나서자, 정부가 북한의 핵 개발이 근본 원인이라고 반박하며 중국의 ‘건설적 역할’을 촉구했다. 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 방북과 북중관계 강화 움직임 속에서 북한과 중국이 전략적으로 한미 동맹을 겨냥하는 공조에 나선 것인지 주목된다.)

item.title: President Lee to Visit Marine Corps Division Tomorrow... 'Security Drive' for Korean War Remembrance Week (이 대통령, 내일 해병부대 찾는다…6·25 주간 ‘안보 드라이브’)
item.description:
The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae announced on the 23rd that President Lee Jae-myung will hold a series of security-related events to mark Korean War Remembrance Week. (이재명 대통령이 6·25 주간을 맞아 안보 일정을 잇달아 진행할 예정이라고 23일 청와대가 밝혔다.)

On the 24th, President Lee plans to visit a Marine Corps division and inspect other security sites. On the 25th, he will attend the 76th anniversary ceremony of the Korean War and a reception for veterans and their families. On the 26th, he will chair a strategy meeting to foster future-oriented innovative security enterprises. (이 대통령은 24일 해병 부대 방문 등 안보 현장을 시찰하고, 25일에는 6·25 전쟁 76주년 기념식과 참전용사·유가족 위로연에 참석한다. 26일에는 미래 신안보 혁신기업을 육성하기 위한 전략회의를 주재한다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung said, "These events are arranged to honor the heroes of the Korean War and to emphasize stronger national defense through robust security and innovation, coinciding with Korean War Remembrance Week and the Month of Patriots and Veterans." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 “이 대통령이 6·25 전쟁일 주간과 호국보훈의 달을 맞아 호국 영웅들을 기리고 튼튼한 안보와 혁신으로 더 강한 국방력을 강조하기 위해 마련한 일정”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Roh Tae-ak defends 'overseas trips with spouse' by saying "That's how it's always been done" (노태악 ‘부부 해외 출장’에…“지금까지 전부 다 그렇게 해왔다고 해”)
item.description:
Former National Election Commission (NEC) Chairperson Roh Tae-ak, regarding his overseas trips with his spouse during his tenure as chairperson, said on the 23rd, "Looking at it from today's perspective, I deeply apologize for the fact that it might appear inappropriate to the public." (노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 23일 위원장 재임 당시 해외 출장을 부부 동반으로 다녀온 데 대해 “지금 관점에서 보면 국민들에게 그렇게(부적절하게) 비쳐지는 점에 대해서 대단히 송구스럽게 생각하고 있다”고 말했다.)

The former chairperson made these remarks while attending the second plenary session of the Special Committee on Parliamentary Inspection for Fact-Finding and Election Management Reform regarding the violation of the people's right to vote, such as the shortage of ballots in the June 3 local elections and other issues, held at the National Assembly on that day. (노 전 위원장은 이날 국회에서 열린 ‘6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사 특별위원회’(국조특위) 2차 전체회의에 출석해 이렇게 말했다.)

When Special Committee Chairperson Yoon Sang-hyun asked, "Are you willing to return funds if there was any improper use (regarding the trips with your spouse)?" Former Chairperson Roh responded, "If there was such a thing, I will find a way to return it through possible methods." (윤상현 특위위원장이 ‘(부부 동반 출장과 관련해) 부당한 자금이 있다면 반환할 용의가 있느냐’고 묻자 노 전 위원장은 “가능한 방법을 통해 그런 점이 있었으면 반환할 방법을 강구하겠다”고 답했다.)

Regarding the background of taking three overseas trips with his spouse during his tenure, Former Chairperson Roh explained, "I never requested it first," but added, "I asked (the staff) if traveling as a couple was possible, and they said it has always been done that way without any objection, so I didn't have any particular doubts." (노 전 위원장은 재임 당시 세 차례 배우자 동반으로 해외 출장을 다녀온 배경에 대해 “제가 먼저 요구한 바는 없다”면서도 “부부 동반이 가능하냐고 (실무진에 물었는데) 지금까지 전부 다, 틀림없이 그렇게 해왔고 아무런 이의제기한 바도 없어 특별히 큰 의문을 갖지 않았다”고 해명했다.)

By Jang Na-rae, reporter wing@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon, reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon Targets ‘Gap’ Amid Jang Dong-hyuk’s Hospitalization… ‘Image of Efforts for Party Reentry’ Politics (장동혁 입원 ‘틈새 공략’ 나선 한동훈…‘복당 노력 이미지’ 정치)
item.description:
While Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, is hospitalized for health reasons, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon and Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon are increasing their contacts with PPP lawmakers. Seizing on the ongoing negative sentiment toward Jang’s leadership, they appear to be kickstarting competition over the initiative for ‘conservative reconstruction.’ (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 건강상의 이유로 입원한 사이, 한동훈 무소속 의원과 오세훈 서울시장이 국민의힘 의원들과 접점을 늘리고 있다. 이들은 장동혁 지도부에 대한 비토 여론이 이어지는 틈을 타 ‘보수 재건’ 주도권 경쟁에 시동을 거는 모양새다.)

Lawmaker Han attended a parliamentary debate on ‘the violation of suffrage rights and electoral system reform’ held at the National Assembly on the 23rd. The event, hosted by pro-Han lawmaker Lee Seong-kwon of the PPP, saw participation from 16 PPP lawmakers, including not only pro-Han members like Park Jeong-ha and Woo Jae-joon but also lawmakers Joo Ho-young and Kim Ki-hyun. In his congratulatory remarks, Han said, “A landslide victory in the 2028 (general election) and reclaiming power in the 2030 (presidential election) are the goals of conservative reconstruction.” Mayor Oh was initially announced to attend the debate, but later only delivered his congratulatory remarks in writing. A source from Oh’s side said, “It was originally planned to only provide written greetings, but it was incorrectly reported that he would attend.” <<> Since entering the assembly, Han has been actively engaging with PPP lawmakers. He previously joined the ‘Future Innovation Forum,’ chaired by lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun, on the 16th, and had dinner on the 21st with lawmakers Jeong Seong-guk, Gwak Gyu-taek, Kim Dae-sik, and Kim Do-eup, who have constituencies in Busan. He also signed on as a co-sponsor of a bill to abolish early voting, proposed by lawmaker Park Dae-chul. However, Han’s camp is drawing a line against immediate plans to rejoin the PPP. A pro-Han lawmaker said, “Rather than trying to rejoin right away, this is to prevent any talk that ‘Han Dong-hoon didn’t make an effort to return.’” <<> Mayor Oh is scheduled to speak as a lecturer at the Future Innovation Forum’s seminar on the 24th. <<> Mayor Oh has also increased contact with PPP lawmakers, including a luncheon meeting with lawmaker Na Kyung-won, who previously served as an advisor to Seoul’s election campaign committee, and planning a dinner schedule with PPP lawmakers from the National Assembly’s Public Administration and Security Committee and Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Committee. In the process of the June 3 local elections, Oh clashed with leader Jang, emphasizing, “I will surely rebuild an opposition party that acts like one and a conservative party that acts like one.” <<> Reporter Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr ( 한 의원은 23일 국회에서 열린 ‘참정권 침해 사태와 선거제도 개혁을 위한 국회 토론회’에 참석했다. 친한(한동훈)계 이성권 국민의힘 의원이 주최한 행사에는 박정하·우재준 의원 등 친한계뿐만 아니라, 주호영·김기현 의원 등 국민의힘 의원 16명이 참석했다. 한 의원은 격려사에서 “2028년 (총선) 압승, 2030년 (대선에서) 정권을 되찾아오는 것이 보수 재건 목표”라고 말했다. 오 시장도 이날 토론회에 참석한다고 공지했다가 서면으로만 격려사를 전달했다. 오 시장 쪽은 “원래 서면 인사말만 제공한다고 했는데 참석한다고 잘못 알려졌다”고 했다. )

item.title: President Lee courts 20s and 30s amid falling approval ratings: "Youth policies to be pushed with speed" (‘지지율 하락’ 2030에 공 들이는 이 대통령…“청년 정책 속도감 있게”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung is actively working to win back the hearts of the 20s and 30s generation, as his approval ratings among them show a clear downward trend, by repeatedly delivering messages targeting them. (이재명 대통령이 지지율 하락세가 뚜렷한 2030세대를 향한 메시지를 거푸 내놓으며 청년 민심 다잡기에 나서고 있다.)

In his opening remarks at a Cabinet meeting and emergency economic review meeting held at the presidential office on the 23rd, President Lee said, "Behind the remarkable achievement of a skyrocketing stock market fueled by the semiconductor boom, a deep shadow of asset polarization looms. In particular, the younger generation, who lack opportunities to build assets through stable jobs and income, are the most marginalized," adding, "Please finalize and swiftly implement policies to expand the ladder of opportunities across all areas of young people's lives, including jobs, asset building, entrepreneurship, and housing." (이 대통령은 23일 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의 머리발언에서 “반도체 호황으로 주식시장 급성장이라는 눈부신 성과의 이면에는 자산 양극화라고 하는 그늘이 짙게 드리우고 있다. 특히 안정적 일자리와 소득을 통해 자산을 형성할 기회 자체가 부족한 청년세대는 가장 큰 소외자들이다”라며 “일자리, 자산 형성, 창업, 주거 등 청년들의 삶 전 영역에서 기회의 사다리를 확대하기 위한 정책을 조속하게 확정하고 속도감 있게 추진해 달라”고 말했다.)

President Lee continued, "There is no single solution to resolve all the problems currently faced by this generation. If there were, we would have already done it," emphasizing, "That's why meticulous and persistent efforts to give more opportunities to young people across all policies are so important." (이 대통령은 이어 “현재 청년세대가 직면한 이런 문제들을 일거에 해소할 왕도는 없다. 그런 게 있다면 이미 다 했겠죠”라며 “정책 전반에 걸쳐 청년에게 더 많은 기회를 주기 위한 세심하고 꾸준한 노력이 그래서 중요하다”고 말했다.)

Furthermore, President Lee urged the active promotion and management of the 'Youth Future Savings Account,' for which applications began on the 22nd. This savings account is one of President Lee's key campaign promises, a financial product allowing young people aged 19 to 34 to deposit up to 500,000 won per month freely over three years. Combining interest, government contributions, and tax exemptions, the effective interest rate reaches 13.2-14.4% annually for the standard type and 18.2-19.4% for the preferential type. (그러면서 이 대통령은 지난 22일부터 신청을 받기 시작한 청년미래적금을 적극적으로 홍보하고 관리해 달라고 당부했다. 청년미래적금은 이 대통령의 핵심 공약으로 만 19~34살 청년이 월 최대 50만원까지 3년간 자유롭게 납입할 수 있는 금융상품이다. 이자·기여금·비과세 혜택을 합산하면 실질 금리가 일반형 연 13.2~14.4%, 우대형은 연 18.2~19.4%에 이른다.)

President Lee also mentioned the incident where a female firefighter in her 20s, affiliated with the Gwangju Fire Safety Headquarters, made an extreme choice due to forced drinking at work. President Lee strongly criticized the incident as "the worst kind of workplace bullying," stating, "The problem is that they don't even realize it's a serious act. I hope each ministry and agency will pay special attention. Please conduct thorough internal checks." He added, "Things like trying to seat a female employee next to a senior, making her pour drinks, forcing her to attend a second round and down a glass in one shot. If someone doesn't want to drink, why force them? Drink it yourself," and stressed, "Please ensure that workplace bullying does not happen again." (이 대통령은 광주 소방안전본부 소속 20대 여성 소방관이 직장 내 음주 강요로 극단적 선택을 한 사건도 언급했다. 이 대통령은 이 사건을 “최악의 갑질”이라고 강하게 질타하며 “문제는 그게 심각한 행위인지 모른다는 것이다. 각 부처, 청에서 각별히 챙겨주면 좋겠다. 내부 조직 점검을 꼭 해보라”고 말했다. 그러면서 “여직원을 상사 옆자리에 앉히려 한다든지 여성 직원에게 술 따르게 한다든지 2차에 강제로 데려가 원샷을 시킨다든지. 술이 싫다는데 왜 원샷을 시키냐. 자기나 먹지”라며 “직장 내 갑질이 다시 나오지 않게 챙겨 달라”고 말했다.)

This is not the first time President Lee has emphasized his focus on the youth. At a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration on the 8th, regarding the ballot shortage incident at the National Election Commission, he said, "I truly have respect for the young people who pointed out the problem." Last July, following the hiring of two 'Youth Affairs Officers' at the presidential office, in April he instructed considering the creation of a youth research institute or government policy department within the presidential office. (이 대통령이 청년에 대한 관심을 강조한 것은 이번이 처음이 아니다. 이 대통령은 지난 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 중앙선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “문제를 지적하는 청년들에 대해 참으로 존경할 만하다는 생각이 든다”고 말했다. 지난해 7월에는 청와대에 ‘청년담당관’ 2명을 채용한 데 이어, 4월에는 청년 연구 기관이나 정부 정책 부서를 청와대 안에 만들지 고민해보라고 지시했다.)

President Lee's efforts to court the youth are not unrelated to signs of disaffection among the 20s and 30s generation. In a survey conducted by Realmeter on behalf of the Energy Economy News from the 15th to the 19th among 2,517 eligible voters aged 18 and older nationwide (100% wireless, automated response, margin of error ±2% points at a 95% confidence level), President Lee's positive job approval rating among those in their 20s fell 6.2 percentage points from the previous week to 30.6%, and among those in their 30s, it dropped 2.4 percentage points to 34.4%. (이 대통령이 청년에 공을 들이는 것은 2030세대의 이탈 조짐과 무관하지 않다. 리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난 15∼19일 전국 18살 이상 유권자 2517명을 대상으로 실시한 무선(100%) 자동응답 방식의 조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±2%포인트)에서 20대의 이 대통령 국정수행 긍정평가는 전주보다 6.2%포인트 떨어진 30.6%였고, 30대는 2.4%포인트 하락한 34.4%였다.)

The presidential office and the government are pondering ways to gather the sentiments of the youth. Considering that the youth employment rate has been declining for 25 consecutive months, government ministries are preparing 'youth job recovery plans,' including expanding public sector hiring. A presidential official stated, "We are considering institutional mechanisms or bodies that can collect the voices of young people." (청와대와 정부는 청년 민심 수렴 방안을 고심하고 있다. 정부 부처에서는 청년 고용률이 25개월 연속 감소세를 보이는 상황을 고려해 공공부문 채용 확대 등 ‘청년 일자리 회복 방안’을 마련하고 있다. 청와대 관계자는 “청년들의 목소리를 수렴할 수 있는 제도적 장치나 기구 등에 대해 고민하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Song Young-gil warms up, may join hands with Kim Min-seok… possibility of an alliance to 'check Chung Cheong-rae' (몸 푸는 송영길, 김민석과 손 잡나…‘정청래 견제’ 연대 가능성)
item.description:
It was confirmed on the 23rd that Song Young-gil, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, recently had an unofficial dinner with President Lee Jae-myung. Amid Song's escalating offensive against Representative Chung Cheong-rae, who is widely expected to seek re-election, there are predictions within the party that Song might run in the party convention, about 50 days away, forming a 'Song Young-gil-Kim Min-seok' united front to stand against Representative Chung. (송영길 더불어민주당 의원이 최근 이재명 대통령과 비공식 만찬을 한 것으로 23일 확인됐다. 송 의원이 최근 연임 도전이 확실시되는 정청래 대표를 향한 공세 수위를 높이는 가운데, 당내에서는 50여일 앞으로 다가온 전당대회에 송 의원이 출마해 정 대표와 맞서는 ‘송영길-김민석’ 연합 전선이 꾸려질 수 있다는 전망이 나온다.)

A ruling party source said that on the 18th, the day President Lee returned from his European tour, including attending the G7 summit, Song had a private dinner with him at the presidential residence in Hannam-dong, Yongsan-gu, Seoul. The source told The Hankyoreh, "I understand they had a wide-ranging discussion on current political issues." A source close to Song also said, "The two have a long-standing camaraderie, so meeting at any time is not particularly unusual." Song has a connection with Lee, having given up his parliamentary seat to run in the 2022 Seoul mayoral election, thereby passing on his constituency of Gyeyang-gu in Incheon, where he had served five terms, to then-candidate Lee Jae-myung. (송 의원은 이 대통령이 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 참석 등 유럽 순방을 마치고 귀국한 당일인 지난 18일 서울 용산구 한남동 대통령 관저에서 이 대통령과 비공개로 저녁 식사를 했다고 여권 관계자가 밝혔다. 이 관계자는 한겨레에 “정국 현안에 대해 폭넓게 이야기한 것으로 안다”고 했다. 송 의원 쪽 관계자도 “두분이 오랜 동지적 관계인 만큼 언제 만나더라도 특별한 일은 아니”라고 했다. 송 의원은 2022년 서울시장 선거 출마를 위해 의원직을 내려놓으면서 자신이 5선을 지낸 인천 계양을 지역구를 이재명 당시 후보에게 이어준 인연이 있다.)

Both inside and outside the Democratic Party, various interpretations are emerging in conjunction with the possibility of Song running in the party convention. With Representative Chung and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok likely to run for party leadership, if Song joins, creating a three-way race, it could form a 'united front' against Representative Chung. On the 21st, Song told KBC Gwangju Broadcasting, "Is the ruling party's leader now opposing the president?" He left the door open, saying, "Whether I run in the party convention will depend on what decision Representative Chung makes." (민주당 안팎에서는 송 의원의 전당대회 출마 가능성과 맞물려 다양한 해석이 나오고 있다. 정 대표와 김민석 국무총리의 당 대표 선거 출마가 유력한 상황에서 송 의원까지 가세해 3파전이 펼쳐지게 된다면, 정 대표에 맞서는 ‘연합 전선’이 만들어질 수 있다는 것이다. 송 의원은 지난 21일 케이비시(KBC)광주방송에서 “집권당의 대표가 지금 대통령과 맞서자는 것인가”라며 “(전당대회 출마 여부는) 정 대표가 어떤 결정을 할지 지켜보겠다”고 가능성을 열어뒀다.)

A lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented, "Since Prime Minister Kim is still in office and cannot take the lead, Song could play the role of attacking Representative Chung. If Prime Minister Kim fully enters the party leadership race, a cooperative structure might be possible." There are also prospects that support from party members, which is advantageous for Representative Chung, might be diverted toward Song, potentially creating a runoff election scenario. According to the party's constitution and rules, if three or more candidates run for party leader and no one secures a majority in the first round of voting, a runoff is held between the top two candidates. (한 수도권 의원은 이에 대해 “김 총리가 아직 총리직을 유지하고 있어 전면에 나서기 어려운 만큼, 송 의원이 정 대표를 향해 공세하는 역할을 할 수 있다”며 “김 총리가 당권 경쟁에 본격적으로 뛰어들면 연대하는 구도가 가능하지 않겠느냐”고 말했다. 정 대표에게 유리한 권리당원의 지지세를 송 의원 쪽으로 분산시켜, 결선투표 구도를 만들 수 있다는 전망도 나온다. 민주당 당헌·당규에 따르면 당 대표 선거에 3명 이상이 출마해 1차 경선에서 과반 득표자가 나오지 않을 경우, 최다 득표자 2명을 대상으로 결선투표를 한다. )

A two-term lawmaker said, "There is a consensus on the need to check Representative Chung, but individual political goals may differ, so we need to see if the alliance will last to the end." Lawmaker Kim Young-ho, close to Song, appeared on SBS Radio and said, "It seems he will run. He seems to be warming up gradually." Song, who is currently visiting the United States, plans to return to Korea on the 27th after meeting with House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries. (한 재선 의원은 “정 대표를 견제해야 한다는 점에서 공감대를 이루지만 개별적인 정치적 지향점은 다를 수 있기 때문에 연대가 끝까지 이어질지는 지켜봐야 한다”고 했다. 송 의원과 가까운 김영호 의원은 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오에 출연해 “(선거에) 나올 것 같다. 슬슬 몸을 푸는 것 같다”고 했다. 미국을 방문 중인 송 의원은 민주당 하원 원내대표 하킴 제프리스 등을 만난 뒤 오는 27일 귀국한다.)

Meanwhile, Representative Chung attended an event at the Kim Dae-jung Nobel Peace Prize Memorial Hall in Mokpo, South Jeolla Province on this day. Following visits to North and South Jeolla on the 19th and 20th, he returned to the region after three days, courting the sentiments of Honam party members. Representative Chung is expected to announce his position either at the Supreme Council meeting on the 24th or following the formation of the party convention preparatory committee on the 26th. Prime Minister Kim, who traveled to China on the 22nd to attend the annual meeting of the World Economic Forum (WEF), will return to Korea on the 24th. (한편 정 대표는 이날 전남 목포 김대중 노벨평화상 기념관 행사에 참석했다. 지난 19~20일 전북·전남을 찾은 데 이어 사흘 만에 다시 이 지역을 찾아 호남 당심에 구애하는 모습이다. 정 대표는 24일 최고위원회의나 26일 전당대회준비위원회 구성을 계기로 거취를 표명할 것으로 보인다. 하계 세계경제포럼(WEF) 연례회의 참석차 지난 22일 중국 출장을 간 김 총리는 24일 귀국한다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Fighting the December 12 Rebellion' Lt. Col. Kim Oh-rang and Petty Officer Jeong Seon-yeop Awarded Combat Merit Medal (‘12·12 반란 맞서 전사’ 김오랑 중령·정선엽 하사, 무공훈장 수여)
item.description:
The government decided at a Cabinet meeting on the 23rd to posthumously award the Chungmu Combat Merit Medal to the late Lt. Col. Kim Oh-rang and the late Petty Officer Jeong Seon-yeop, who were killed fighting against rebel forces during the December 12 military rebellion in 1979. (정부는 23일 국무회의에서 1979년 12·12 군사반란 당시 반란군에 맞서 싸우다 전사한 고 김오랑 중령과 고 정선엽 하사에게 충무무공훈장 추서를 결정했다.)

The government had considered posthumously awarding a combat merit medal to Lt. Col. Kim, but due to legal restrictions under the Decoration Act that prohibit duplicate awards, the existing National Security Medal previously granted to Kim was revoked in March, followed by the new posthumous award of the Chungmu Combat Merit Medal on this day. The National Security Medal is awarded for non-combat contributions, while the Combat Merit Medal recognizes achievements in battle. Lt. Col. Kim, who served as chief of staff to Special Warfare Commander General Jeong Byeong-ju during the December 12 coup in 1979, died in a gunfight with rebel forces who stormed the commander's office to arrest General Jeong. (정부는 김 중령에게 무공훈장 추서를 검토하였으나, 상훈법상 ‘중복 수여의 금지’에 따라 훈장을 거듭 수여할 수 없는 법적 제약이 있어, 지난 3월 기존에 수여된 김 중령의 보국훈장을 취소한 데 이어 이날 충무무공훈장을 새로 추서했다. 보국훈장은 전투 이외 공적을, 무공훈장은 전투 중 세운 공적을 대상으로 하는 훈장이다. 1979년 12·12 쿠데타 당시 정병주 특전사령관의 비서실장이었던 김 중령은 정 사령관을 체포하러 사령관실에 들이닥친 반란군과 총격전을 벌이다 숨졌다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Justifies "Expanding and Strengthening Nuclear Forces" by Citing South Korea's Nuclear Submarine Plans (김정은, 한국 핵잠 추진 거론하며 “핵무력 확대·강화” 정당화)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un has justified the strengthening of nuclear capabilities and military forces, claiming that South Korea's pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines and the operation of the Nuclear Consultative Group (NCG), a South Korea-U.S. extended deterrence consultative body, are driving the Korean Peninsula into a nuclear war crisis. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 한국의 핵추진잠수함 보유 추진과 한-미 확장억제 협의체인 핵협의그룹(NCG) 가동이 한반도를 핵전쟁의 위기로 내몰고 있다며 핵 능력과 군사력 강화를 정당화했다.)

According to a report by the Rodong Sinmun on the 23rd, Kim stated at the conclusion of the 2nd Enlarged Meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, held from the 20th to the 22nd, that "the United States and South Korea are increasingly blatant in their moves to augment and modernize forces in the region, even pushing to possess South Korean nuclear submarines." He added, "What is more dangerous is that the U.S. and South Korea have again opened a military simulation theater of the Nuclear Consultative Group, a nuclear war mechanism aimed at attacking our republic, by incorporating nuclear elements such as a nuclear-conventional integrated posture." Kim also claimed regarding the six rounds of South Korea-U.S. NCG discussions held up until the 9th that "a nuclear war script has been drawn up" and that "this is pushing the situation on the Korean Peninsula to the brink of nuclear war." <<> Kim then stated, "Continuously expanding and strengthening nuclear forces and thoroughly exercising the status of a nuclear weapons state is the most correct and only path." This reveals North Korea's perception that its expansion of nuclear forces is a legitimate response to the South Korea-U.S. buildup of nuclear armaments. Kim referred to South Korea as "the most hostile state" and said, "We must thoroughly adhere to the principle of struggle against the enemy." This reaffirms the relationship of "hostile two states." <<> Kim mentioned major defense projects, including the construction of a 10,000-ton strategic missile cruiser decided by the Party Central Military Commission in April, fortification of the southern border, and building naval bases, portraying these military force enhancements as a "proportional response" to South Korea's military buildup. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, told The Hankyoreh, "This enlarged meeting seems to be the first time Kim directly mentioned the South Korea-U.S. nuclear submarines or the NCG. With (South Korea-U.S.) cooperation becoming more visible, Kim’s mention at this meeting, which included key military commanders, appears aimed at strengthening the justification for nuclear force augmentation and signaling the intention to prepare deterrence measures." A foreign ministry official said to reporters on the same day, "The South Korea-U.S. extended deterrence cooperation aligns with the international nonproliferation regime, and our development of nuclear submarines is a response to the advancement of North Korea's nuclear and missile capabilities and other security conditions on the Korean Peninsula." <<> Meanwhile, at this enlarged meeting, Jo Yong-won, considered the second-in-command in the Kim Jong-un regime and a "doorkeeper power," moved from his post as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly to become a Central Committee Secretary and head of the Organization and Guidance Department. This unusual personnel change, occurring just three months after he became the head of the Supreme People's Assembly, is interpreted as an attempt to bolster Kim's control. It may also be aimed at addressing corruption issues that have emerged within the military. Chang Yong-seok, a visiting research fellow at Seoul National University's Institute for Peace and Unification Studies, said, "The organization secretary plays a role in organizational control. Kim sending a close aide like Jo Yong-won indicates he needed a figure capable of playing a role across state affairs generally." <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (김 위원장은 지난 20∼22일 열린 노동당 중앙위원회 제9기 제2차 전원회의 확대회의 결론에서 “미국과 한국은 지역 내 무력증강 및 현대화 책동을 날로 로(노)골화하면서 한국의 핵잠수함 보유까지 추진하고 있다”며 “보다 위험한 것은 미·한이 핵·재래식 통합 태세 등 핵요소를 동반하여 우리 공화국을 공격하기 위한 핵전쟁 기구인 핵협의그룹의 군사적 모의판을 또다시 벌려놓은 것”이라고 말했다고 노동신문이 23일 보도했다. 김 위원장은 지난 9일까지 모두 6차례 열린 한-미 핵협의그룹 논의에 대해서는 “핵전쟁 각본이 작성됐다”며 “조선반도 정세를 핵전쟁의 문어구(문어귀)로 떠밀고 있다”고 주장했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Amid Growth in Semiconductors and Stocks, Asset Polarization... Young People's Sense of Alienation Is Heartbreaking" (이 대통령 “반도체·주식 성장 속 자산 양극화…청년 소외감 뼈아파”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 23rd, "While there are achievements such as the semiconductor boom and the rapid growth of stocks, a shadow of asset polarization looms large on the other side," and urged cabinet members to consider policies across the board to prevent young people from losing opportunities due to polarization. (이재명 대통령이 23일 “반도체 호황과 주식 급성장이라는 성과가 있지만, 그 이면에는 자산 양극화라는 그늘이 짙게 드리우고 있다”며 청년들이 양극화로 인해 기회를 잃지 않도록 정책 전반에 걸쳐 고민해달라고 국무위원들에게 주문했다.)

At a cabinet meeting held at the Blue House that day, President Lee stated, "The government must painfully acknowledge the sense of alienation among young people, who feel that 'record-breaking bonuses or the KOSPI are stories from a different world for me.'" He added, "Young people who lack the opportunity to build assets through stable jobs and income are the most marginalized in today's era." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 연 국무회의에서 “역대급 성과급이나 코스피에도 ‘나에겐 다른 세상 이야기’라는 (청년들의) 소외감을 정부가 뼈아프게 받아들여야 한다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “안정적 일자리와 소득을 통해 자산을 형성할 기회 자체가 부족한 청년들은 현시대의 가장 큰 소외자들”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the National Election Commission, which has been embroiled in controversy over poor election management, President Lee said, "It is an independent agency established by the Constitution, making it impossible to control," and ordered an increase in investigative personnel from the joint police-prosecution investigation team probing the commission, expanding the scope of the probe to include hiring irregularities, corruption, and budget misuse. (또 부실 선거 관리로 논란에 휩싸인 선거관리위원회에 대해서는 “헌법이 정한 독립기관이라 통제가 불가능하다”며 선관위를 수사하는 검경 합동수사본부 수사인력을 늘리고 채용 비리와 부정부패, 예산 남용까지 수사 범위를 확대하라고 지시했다.)

President Lee also addressed the government-introduced maximum oil price system, aimed at preventing a sharp rise in oil prices due to the Middle Eastern war, saying, "We should boldly maintain it and even lower the maximum price further." He also instructed officials to research measures to support low-income households amid income polarization. (이 대통령은 중동 전쟁으로 인한 유가 급등 상황을 막고자 정부가 도입한 석유 최고가격제와 관련해 “과감하게 더 유지하고, 최고가격도 좀 낮춰야 할 거 같다”고 말했다. 아울러 소득 양극화로 인한 서민 소득지원 방안도 연구하라고 지시했다.)

item.title: NEC Secretariat: “May Constitute Grounds for Re-Election”…Reported in Early Morning Meeting on June 4 (선관위 사무처 “재투표 사유 해당할 수도”…6월4일 새벽 회의서 보고)
item.description:
It has been learned that during a meeting of the National Election Commission (NEC) in the early hours of June 4, the day after the June 3 local elections, the secretariat reported a legal interpretation stating that the shortage of ballot papers “may constitute grounds for a re-election.” (6·3 지방선거 다음날인 4일 새벽 중앙선거관리위원회 회의에서 사무처가 투표용지 부족사태에 관해 “재투표 사유에 해당할 수도 있다”는 법리 해석을 보고한 것으로 파악됐다.)

According to annexes of the meeting minutes submitted to the office of Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Nam-hee on the 23rd, the secretariat reported on “a summary regarding whether the shortage of ballot papers constitutes grounds for postponing the election” at the meeting that began at 12:38 a.m. on the 4th. (23일 김남희 더불어민주당 의원실이 중앙선관위로부터 제출받은 회의록 부속서류를 보면 사무처 해석과는 4일 오전 0시38분 시작한 회의에서 ‘투표용지 부족에 따른 선거연기 사유 해당 여부 등 정리’를 보고했다.)

The secretariat’s interpretation department reported that “since there are voters who were unable to vote due to the ballot paper shortage, it can be seen as falling under ‘other unavoidable reasons’ (under Article 198, Paragraph 1 of the Public Official Election Act).” Article 198, Paragraph 1 of the Public Official Election Act stipulates that grounds for a re-election include “cases where voting in any polling district cannot be conducted due to natural disasters, other unavoidable reasons, or loss or destruction of ballot boxes.” (사무처 해석과는 “투표용지 부족으로 투표를 하지 못한 선거인이 있으므로 (공직선거법 198조 1항의) ‘기타 부득이한 사유’에 해당한다고 볼 수도 있다”라고 보고했다. 공직선거법 198조 1항은 재투표 사유에 대해 ‘천재·지변 기타 부득이한 사유로 인해 어느 투표구의 투표를 실시하지 못한 때와 투표함의 분실·멸실 등의 사유가 발생한 때’라고 규정하고 있다. )

The interpretation department cited this provision along with a 1960 Supreme Court precedent, which held that “‘cases where voting in any polling district cannot be conducted’ includes cases where some voters are unable to vote.” It also reported that “if it is deemed unlikely to affect the election result in the relevant electoral district, the winner can be determined without holding a re-election; however, such a judgment requires the completion of the vote-counting process.” In other words, if the difference in votes between the winner and the loser is greater than the difference between the total number of voters in the polling district and the number of voters who actually voted, it can be considered unlikely to affect the election result. It also stated that the decision on whether to hold a re-election rests with the relevant electoral district election commission. (해석과는 이 규정과 함께 1960년 대법원 판례(‘어느 투표구의 투표를 실시하지 못한 때’는 일부의 투표권자가 투표를 행하지 못한 경우를 포함)를 함께 근거로 들었다. 또 해석과는 “재투표가 당해 선거구의 선거결과에 영향을 미칠 염려가 없다고 인정되는 때에는 재투표를 실시하지 아니하고 당선인을 결정할 수 있으나, 이와 같은 판단을 위해서는 개표절차 종료가 필요하다”고 보고했다. 당선인과 낙선인 간의 득표수 차이가 투표구 전체 선거인 수에서 투표한 선거인 수의 차이보다 클 경우에는 선거구의 선거결과에 영향을 미칠 염려가 없다고 볼 수 있다는 것이다. 또 재투표 여부 결정 주체는 관할 선거구 선관위라고도 했다. )

Additionally, the interpretation department clarified that there were no grounds for postponing the election or for a by-election, and that there were no legal provisions for stopping vote counting or invalidating the election. Unlike a by-election (Article 195 of the Public Official Election Act), which starts the entire process anew from candidate registration, a re-election (Article 198 of the Public Official Election Act) involves holding a new vote only in the specific affected polling district and then adding the results to the existing totals. (아울러 해석과는 선거연기 사유, 재선거 사유에는 해당하지 않고 개표중단, 선거무효 결정은 근거 규정이 없다고 밝혔다. 후보 등록부터 절차 전체를 새롭게 하는 재선거(공직선거법 195조)와 달리, 재투표(공직선거법 198조)는 문제가 된 특정 선거구 투표만 다시 해 기존 결과에 합산하게 돼있다.)

At the time, the NEC issued a statement saying that “it does not constitute grounds for postponing the election or a by-election under the Public Official Election Act,” and that “it is impossible to stop the ongoing vote counting.” However, it did not mention a re-election. (당시 선관위는 입장문을 내고 “공직선거법에 따른 선거의 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다”면서 “현재 진행되는 개표를 중단하는 것은 불가하다”라고 밝혔다. 하지만 재투표에 대해 언급하지는 않았다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ballot Paper Ignites Power Game... 'By-Election Civil War' in People Power Party, 'Jeong Cheong-rae's Fate' in Democratic Party [Gongdeok Pocha] (투표용지가 불붙인 권력 게임…국힘 ‘재선거 내전’·민주 ‘정청래 거취’ [공덕포차])
item.description:
Concerns are emerging within the ruling party over the appointments of new Presidential Civil Affairs Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik and Judicial System Secretary Park Ji-young. (한찬식 신임 청와대 민정수석과 박지영 사법제도비서관 인선을 둘러싸고 여당 안에서 우려의 목소리가 나오고 있습니다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong stated in a CBS radio interview on the 23rd that the appointment of Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik prioritized not only the will and ability for prosecution reform but also a thorough understanding of the internal organization of the prosecution. The intent is that a high level of understanding of the prosecution—the target of reform—would actually facilitate the smooth completion of prosecution reform. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 23일 CBS 라디오 인터뷰에서 한찬식 수석 임명 배경에 대해 검찰 개혁 의지와 능력뿐 아니라 검찰 내부 조직에 대한 파악 정도를 중요하게 봤다고 밝혔습니다. 개혁 대상인 검찰 조직에 대한 이해도가 높아야 오히려 검찰 개혁을 순조롭게 마무리할 수 있다는 취지입니다.)

Nevertheless, within the ruling party's support base, a so-called 'indictment withdrawal deal theory' has emerged, suggesting that the appointment of Senior Secretary Han Chan-sik is an attempt to secure an indictment withdrawal at the cost of maintaining the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority. Rep. Ko Min-jung, a former spokesperson for the Moon Jae-in administration, criticized on Facebook that Senior Secretary Han, as a prosecutor during the Moon administration, had judged the personnel of that administration as criminal. Gyeonggi Province Governor-elect Choo Mi-ae also expressed a sense of emptiness on Facebook, quoting Jeong Ho-seung's poem 'Shattered to Pieces'. (그럼에도 여당 지지층 내부에서는 한찬식 수석 임명을 통해 검찰의 보완수사권 유지를 대가로 공소취소를 얻어내려는 것 아니냐는 이른바 ‘공소취소 거래설’까지 나오고 있습니다. 문재인 정부 청와대 대변인을 지낸 고민정 의원은 페이스북에 한 수석이 문재인 정부 당시 검사로서 문재인 정부 인사를 범죄로 판단했던 사람이라고 비판했습니다. 추미애 경기도지사 당선인 역시 페이스북에 정호승의 시 ‘산산조각’을 인용하며 허탈함을 토로했습니다.)

Opposition is also mounting over the position of Judicial System Secretary, to which prosecutor-turned-lawyer Park Ji-young was appointed. Since the Judicial System Secretary is a role primarily responsible for prosecution and judicial reform, the core of the controversy lies in the fact that key posts essential for leading prosecution reform have been successively filled with individuals from a prosecution background. (검찰 출신 박지영 변호사가 임명된 사법제도비서관 자리를 두고도 반발이 이어지고 있습니다. 사법제도비서관은 검찰·사법개혁 등을 주무로 하는 자리인 만큼, 검찰개혁을 실질적으로 이끌어야 할 핵심 요직을 연이어 검찰 출신 인사로 채웠다는 점이 논란의 핵심입니다.)

Is this appointment, which fills the key posts responsible for prosecution reform one after another with former prosecutors, a strategic move to finalize reform, or a signal that dulls the momentum for change? Additionally, a recent poll showed positive evaluations, which had consistently maintained a lead since the president's inauguration, falling behind negative evaluations for the first time. What is the reason for this approval rating dead cross? We investigate on 'Gongdeok Pocha'. Check out the video! (검찰개혁을 책임질 핵심 요직을 연이어 검찰 출신으로 채운 이번 인선은, 과연 개혁의 마무리를 위한 포석일까요, 아니면 개혁 동력을 무디게 만드는 신호일까요? 또 대통령 취임 후 줄곧 우위를 지켜온 긍정평가가 처음으로 부정평가에 자리를 내준 여론조사가 나왔는데, 이 지지율 데드크로스의 이유는 무엇일까요? '공덕포차'에서 알아봅니다. 영상으로 확인하시죠!)

item.title: President Lee Hosts Dinner for Diplomatic Corps in Seoul... 118 Nations Gather for Grilled Pork Belly and Chicken and Beer (이 대통령, 주한외교단 초청 만찬…118개국 모여 솥뚜껑삼겹살·치맥)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung invited the diplomatic corps in South Korea to a dinner at the presidential garden of Cheong Wa Dae on the 23rd, sharing diplomatic achievements. (이재명 대통령이 23일 청와대 녹지원으로 주한 외교 사절단을 초청해 만찬을 함께하고 외교 성과를 공유했다.)

In his remarks, President Lee stated, "The Republic of Korea has participated in the G7 summit for two consecutive years and is establishing itself as a responsible partner in the international community," adding, "We will continue to closely cooperate with the international community based on the common values of humanity: freedom, peace, and prosperity." He further encouraged the attendees, saying, "The active summit diplomacy was possible because you faithfully served as a bridge connecting your home countries and South Korea." (이 대통령은 “대한민국은 2년 연속 주요7개국(G7) 정상회의에 참석했고, 국제사회의 책임 있는 파트너로 자리매김하고 있다”며 “앞으로도 자유와 평화, 번영이라는 인류 공동의 가치를 바탕으로 국제사회와 긴밀하게 협력하겠다”고 인사말을 통해 밝혔다. 이어 “활발한 정상 외교를 할 수 있었던 것은 여러분이 본국과 대한민국을 잇는 가교 역할을 충실히 해주셨기 때문”이라고 격려했다.)

President Lee also expressed his willingness to listen to the attendees' opinions, saying, "You likely have much to say to the South Korean government, and there might be things you want to directly tell the presidential office. Incidentally, I have plenty of free time." He also suggested, "I will shout out 'cheers' in Korean, and I ask you to do the same in your respective languages." (이 대통령은 “대한민국 정부에 하고 싶은 얘기가 상당히 많을 것이고, 대통령실에 직접 말씀하고 싶은 것도 있을 것이다. 참고로 의외로 제가 시간이 많이 남는다”면서 참석자들의 의견을 경청하겠다는 뜻을 드러냈다. 또 “저는 대한민국 말로 ‘건배’를 외칠 테니 각국의 언어로 건배를 해달라”고 제안하기도 했다.)

The dinner was attended by the dean of the diplomatic corps, Moroccan Ambassador to South Korea Shafik Rachadi, along with ambassadors from all 118 resident embassies and representatives from 30 international organizations. The head table was shared by ambassadors from Morocco, as well as the United States, Japan, the Philippines, New Zealand, Mongolia, China, the European Union (EU), the Holy See, and Chile. Cheong Wa Dae explained that the seating arrangement was made considering the major summit diplomatic visits and receptions this year, as well as regional representation. (이날 만찬에는 주한 외교단장인 샤픽 라샤디 주한 모로코 대사를 비롯해 전체 118국 상주 공관 대사와 30개 국제기구 대표들이 참석했다. 주빈석에는 모로코와 함께 미국, 일본, 필리핀, 뉴질랜드, 몽골, 중국, 유럽연합(EU), 교황청, 칠레 대사 등이 자리했다. 청와대는 올해 주요 정상외교 방문·접수 국가 및 지역 대표성 등을 고려해 안배한 것이라고 설명했다.)

The dinner menu was served buffet-style, featuring Korean-style charcoal-grilled dishes, "chimaek" (chicken and beer), Korean-style geotjeori (fresh kimchi), and ssambap (rice wraps), with draft beer available. In addition to chicken, the menu included a variety of items such as grilled pork belly cooked on a cauldron lid, charcoal-grilled wagyu beef and LA-style marinated short ribs, lamb ribs, king prawns, chicken sausages, and vegetables. All ingredients except for pork belly were halal-certified. Vegan and other vegetarian options were also prepared. (만찬 메뉴로는 한국식 숯불구이와 ‘치맥’, 한국식 겉절이와 쌈밥 등이 뷔페 형식으로 제공됐고 생맥주를 곁들일 수 있도록 했다. 치킨 외에도 솥뚜껑 삼겹살 구이, 숯불에 구운 쇠고기 와규 및 엘에이(LA) 양념갈비, 양갈비, 왕새우, 치킨 소시지, 채소 등 다양한 메뉴가 제공됐다. 삼겹살을 제외한 모든 식재료는 할랄 인증 제품을 사용했다. 비건 등 채식주의자를 위한 메뉴도 마련했다.)

By Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Noh Tae-ak “Non-standing Election Commission System No Longer Viable”…Wi Cheol-hwan “Constitutional Amendment If Necessary” (노태악 “선관위 비상임체제 더는 불가”…위철환 “필요땐 개헌해야”)
item.description:
On the 23rd, the ruling and opposition parties held a plenary session of the “Special Committee on Parliamentary Investigation for Fact-Finding on Violations of Citizens’ Right to Vote, Including the Ballot Shortage Incident in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, and Election Management Reform” (Election Commission Special Investigation Committee). They criticized former National Election Commission (NEC) Chairperson Noh Tae-ak for the mismanagement of the June 3 local elections and for taking spousal business trips during his tenure. Acting NEC Chairperson Wi Cheol-hwan and former Chairperson Noh stated, “We believe a constitutional amendment should be pursued if necessary,” highlighting the need for a “single-point constitutional amendment.” <<> Acting Chairperson Wi attended the second plenary session of the Election Commission parliamentary investigation at the National Assembly that day. In response to a question from Special Committee Chairperson Yoon Sang-hyun, who asked, “Do you view this incident as more structural than personal, and is that why you proposed introducing a standing chairperson system?” Wi answered, “Yes.” When asked by Jeong Choon-saeng, a lawmaker from the Fatherland Innovation Party, “The Election Commission has reached a point where it cannot avoid audits,” Wi replied, “I believe a single-point constitutional amendment might be necessary.” Former Chairperson Noh also said, “If a constitutional amendment is needed, it should be done.” Wi stated, “The chairperson needs to be a full-time role to take control of the secretariat’s functions. Placing a single standing commissioner in the middle wouldn’t effectively work, as they only hold one-ninth of the voting power. We acknowledge our lack of insight and incompetence. Trusting the secretariat too much was also a contributing factor.” <<> In response to a query from Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Hae-sik, who asked, “Do you believe the non-standing chairperson system should continue?” former Chairperson Noh replied, “I think it is no longer viable.” The system, in place since the NEC’s establishment in 1963, where a Supreme Court justice serves as a part-time chairperson, has been identified as a key cause of internal management failures. Noh bowed his head and said, “As chairperson, I deeply feel responsible for the committee’s failure to manage things thoroughly.” Noh resigned on the 5th, taking responsibility for the incident. <<> During the meeting, former Chairperson Noh’s “spousal business trips” also came under scrutiny. During his tenure, Noh took three overseas trips to Australia, New Zealand, and other locations, accompanied by his spouse. The airfare and accommodation costs for his spouse were all covered by taxpayer money. Noh said, “Looking back from today’s perspective, I deeply regret that this appeared inappropriate to the public.” When Chairperson Yoon asked, “If any funds were improperly used regarding the spousal trips, are you willing to return them?” Noh replied, “I will explore ways to return them if such issues exist, through possible means.” <<> At the start of the meeting, key witnesses, including seven non-standing NEC commissioners, did not appear, prompting both ruling and opposition parties to unanimously denounce it as “a collective defiance against the public.” Five of the seven non-standing commissioners hurriedly attended the afternoon session. Min So-young, former chairperson of the Songpa District Election Commission (Senior Presiding Judge of the Seoul Eastern District Court), who attended in the afternoon, stated in response to questions about the Songpa District Election Commission, “I currently have no knowledge of how the ballots were actually distributed to polling stations, so I cannot provide specific answers.” <<> President Lee Jae-myung, presiding over a Cabinet meeting at the presidential office that day, ordered an increase in personnel from the joint prosecution and police investigation headquarters to probe not only the ballot shortage but also other issues at the NEC, such as budget waste and hiring irregularities. President Lee said, “There has been a lack of internal awareness and lax management.
